items.title: 深圳APEC｜渣打：將發揮網絡優勢 促進區域合作及共同繁榮
items.summary: 渣打香港兼大中華及北亞區行政總裁、亞太經合組織（APEC）商貿諮詢理事會中國香港代表禤惠儀表示，渣打的網絡已覆蓋APEC約3分之2的經濟體，並連接亞洲、非洲及中東的重要市場。 禤惠儀在深圳出席APEC工商領導人峰會時表示，在全球經濟和貿易格局持續演變的背景下，渣打深知開放、自由及互惠的多邊合作，對促進跨境貿易和投資的重要性，致力發揮橋樑作用，促進跨境資金、貿易和投資流動，協助企業把握區域發展機遇。…
items.titleEn: APEC Standards in Shenzhen: Exercise the Internet's strengths to promote regional cooperation and common prosperity
items.summaryEn: The Hong Kong representative of Standard & Poor's Hong Kong and the executive president of Greater China and North Asia, the Asia-Pacific Partnership (APEC) Trade Advisory Board, said that Standard & Poore's network covers about two-thirds of APEC's economies and connects important markets in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Speaking at the APEC Business Leaders Summit in Shenzhen, Xi Jinping said that in the context of the ongoing evolution of the global economic and trade landscape, Standard understands the importance of open, free and reciprocal multilateral cooperation to promote cross-border trade and investment, is committed to serving as a bridge, promoting cross-broad funds, trade and investment flows, and helping businesses seize the opportunities for regional development. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 特首辦：辦公室車輛灣仔遇途人衝出馬路 途人拒送院
items.summary: 行政長官辦公室回覆查詢時表示，一輛特首辦車輛下午約5時48分，在灣仔告士打道慢駛左轉入分域街時，遇到一名途人，在沒有行人過路設施的路段突然衝出馬路，司機及時煞停車輛，並即場報警備案。 特首辦表示，警察到場後確認涉事途人屬違規橫過馬路，而該途人拒絕到醫院接受進一步檢查。事件作備案處理。 編輯：鍾慧儀
items.titleEn: Office: People running out of their cars on the way to the office, people refusing to go to the hospital
items.summaryEn: In response to an inquiry, the Office of the Chief Administrative Officer said that at about 5:48 p.m., a specialised vehicle was driving slowly to the left of the district's streets when it encountered a passerby who suddenly jumped out of the lane in a section of road that was not covered by pedestrian facilities, the driver stopped the vehicle on time, and immediately reported the security incident. Police said the passenger was found to have crossed the road illegally after arriving at the scene, and the passenger refused to go to the hospital for further examination. This is the first time that a man has been arrested in the country. This is the first time I've seen this.

items.title: 大埔詹屋村單位疑電器短路引致火警 女子吸濃煙不適送院
items.summary: 大埔船灣詹屋村一個單位傍晚發生一級火警。一名女子吸入濃煙不適，經救護員初步治理後，清醒送院。 消防處發言人表示，在下午5時59分接報，4分鐘後到達現場，動用一條喉和一隊煙帽隊灌救，火勢於晚上6時18分大致被救熄。 期間約20名居民自行疏散，消防員在起火單位救出兩隻狗及一隻貓，將牠們帶到安全地方。 經調查後，處方相信火警起因沒有可疑。起火位置為涉事單位的客廳，懷疑因電器短路引致。 編輯：鍾慧儀
items.titleEn: Police suspected electrical shortcuts in the village of Jenho in Dhaka led to women smoking heavy cigarettes not suitable for hospitalization
items.summaryEn: In the evening, a first-class firefighter was attacked in the village of Jenho, in the Bay of Bengal. A woman who was exposed to high levels of smoking was taken to the hospital after a preliminary treatment by paramedics. A fire department spokesman said the fire was reported at 5:59 p.m., and four minutes after arriving at the scene, a firefighter and a team of smoke caps were used to water the fire, and the fire was largely extinguished by 6:18 p.m. The firefighters rescued two dogs and a cat from the fire station and took them to safety. After an investigation, the pharmacy believes that the firefighters did not suspect the fire. The fire was located in the living room of the affected unit, which is suspected to have been caused by a short electrical connection. This is the first time I've seen this.

items.title: 北角電燈中心低壓設備異常 一名員工受傷送院
items.summary: 港燈表示，下午約5時接報，位於北角電燈中心地下的一台低壓設備出現異常。消防員接報到場後迅速將火救熄。一名港燈員工受傷，清醒送院接受治療。 港燈十分關注員工的情況，正密切跟進並提供適切支援；同時配合有關部門調查事件起因，會進一步檢查相關設備。 北角電燈中心部分樓層的供電受事故影響，客戶的電力供應則維持正常。 編輯：鍾慧儀
items.titleEn: Low-pressure equipment at the North Corner Lighting Centre abnormal: One worker was taken to hospital with injuries
items.summaryEn: According to Port Light, a low-pressure device under the northern corner of the lighthouse was reported at about 5 p.m. to be unusual. The firefighters quickly reached the scene and rescued the fires. A port light worker was wounded and was rushed to hospital for treatment. Port Light is closely monitoring and providing adequate support for the situation of its employees, while cooperating with the departmental investigation of the incidents and further inspecting the relevant facilities. The power supply of some floors of the North Corner Light Center was affected by the accident, while the power supply of customers remained normal. This is the first time I've seen this.

items.title: 張德康承認錯誤切除病人兩邊卵巢犯很低級錯誤 深感抱歉
items.summary: 一名45歲女病人在中大醫院接受腹腔鏡子宮及雙側輸卵管切除手術期間，兩邊卵巢被錯誤切除。中大醫院顧問醫生、婦科腫瘤科專科醫生張德康接受本台訪問時承認，他是當日施手術的醫生，他說當時很專注於手術，不希望有不必要創傷、流血等，很專注在一事上時，忽略了另一方面。他形容，事故是不應該發生，亦是很低級、不應該犯的錯誤，深感抱歉。…
items.titleEn: Zhang DeCong admitted that the mistake of removing the patient's ovaries from both sides was a low-level mistake.
items.summaryEn: A 45-year-old woman who was admitted to a mid-career hospital after undergoing surgery to remove her cervix and ovaries was wrongly removed. In an interview with the center, Dr. Zhang DeCong, a consultant at Central Hospital, a gynecologist and oncologist, admitted that he was the surgeon who performed the surgery at the time, saying that he was focused on the surgery, not wanting unnecessary injuries, bleeding, etc., and that he focused on one thing and ignored the other. He described the accident as an unfortunate and low-level mistake that shouldn't have been made, and he apologized deeply. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 最後幻彩詠香江匯演加入煙火 大批市民遊客見證告別演出

items.summaryEn: In his opening speech to the "Hong Kong Winter Town: Central Ring", the Director of the Hong Kong Sports and Tourism Office, Luo Pfei, said that from this evening to early next January, the exterior walls of several iconic buildings in Hong Kong will feature photographic exhibitions, while the Winter Town will also be expanded to the shoreline and the Copper Bay, bringing a dual winter photographic experience, reflecting each other with the Central Ring, allowing citizens and tourists to feel the vibrant festive atmosphere of Hong Kong. According to Pompeo, the 22-year-old, world-record-holder in gymnastics, will perform for the last time tonight, adding the element of a smoke flame to the ending of the classic performance.
